positive_snippets: I visited this hotel with my friend for business purpose, It was best experience for me in Delhi over the years. The Hotel is 15 mins drive from airport. Staff was very courteous and friendly. The location of this hotel is perfect to visit anywhere in Delhi by metro or by any other means. Food availability around this hotel best thing. You can get all kind of food at very reasonable rate. The service provided by this hotel is at nice and that too at very reasonable rate. I am staying in this hotel every time i visit Delhi .
